intro: The Shattered Salute is an initiation ritual overseen by Shenthul within the Cleft of Shadows in Orgrimmar. By learning this distinct sign of recognition, budding rogues are taught how to safely identify fellow operatives of the Shattered Hand in the field.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a rogue of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You are now ready to proceed.
